acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p jmap-mail-server --features mdn -- mdn_integration passes all 11 tests with exit 0
description: Write integration tests in tests/ covering both MDN methods. Test vectors come directly from draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §3 examples.
design:
Test file: tests/mdn_integration.rs (compiled only with cfg(feature=mdn)).

MDN/send tests:

send_success: build MemoryMailBackend with one received email that has Disposition-Notification-To header. Call MDN/send with the draft §3.1 request payload. Verify: sent map contains the creation id with server-set fields (finalRecipient, originalMessageId); notSent is null; implicit Email/set updates the source email with $mdnsent: true.

send_already_sent: same setup but pre-set $mdnsent on the email. Verify notSent contains mdnAlreadySent SetError; sent is null; email is unchanged.

send_email_not_found: for_email_id references nonexistent email. Verify notSent contains notFound SetError.

send_no_dnt_header: email exists but has no Disposition-Notification-To header. Verify notSent contains notFound SetError (per draft §2.1).

send_missing_mdnsent_patch: call MDN/send with onSuccessUpdateEmail that does NOT patch keywords/$mdnsent. Verify entire request rejected with invalidArguments (not per-entry error).

send_missing_on_success_entirely: call MDN/send with onSuccessUpdateEmail: null. Verify entire request rejected with invalidArguments.

MDN/parse tests:

parse_valid: upload the hand-crafted MDN blob from draft §3.3 example. Call MDN/parse with its blobId. Verify parsed map contains correct Mdn with all fields; forEmailId set if matching sent email exists; actionMode/sendingMode/type are lowercase.

parse_not_found: call MDN/parse with unknown blobId. Verify notFound contains the id; parsed and notParsable are null.

parse_not_parsable: upload a plain-text blob (not an MDN). Verify notParsable contains the id; parsed and notFound are null.

parse_multiple_mixed: supply three blobIds — one valid MDN, one not parsable, one not found. Verify all three response fields are populated correctly.

parse_for_email_id_null: valid MDN blob whose Original-Message-ID does not match any known email. Verify parsed MDN has forEmailId: null (not absent — the field must be present and null).
title: mdn: integration tests (draft RFC examples)
